say:1:1430218101:1.text: It's not just a plate! I made a mistake! If my lord finds out, I'll be banished!
say:1:1430218101:1.source_cn: 可这是我犯错的证据！要是被主人发现了，他一定揪着这点驱逐我。
say:1:1430218101:1.male: It's not just a plate! I made a mistake! If my lord finds out, I'll be banished!
say:1:1430218101:1.female: It's not just a plate! I made a mistake! If my lord finds out, I'll be banished!

say:2:1430218102:1.text: He always tells me that there are dozens of people waiting to take my place.
say:2:1430218102:1.source_cn: 他总是跟我说，反正等着当仆从的人还有很多……
say:2:1430218102:1.male: He always tells me that there are dozens of people waiting to take my place.
say:2:1430218102:1.female: He always tells me that there are dozens of people waiting to take my place.

say:3:1430218103:1.text: I don't want to return to the commoners' district. I have to think of a way out of this...
say:3:1430218103:1.source_cn: 我不要再回到平民区！得想个办法，对，想个办法……
say:3:1430218103:1.male: I don't want to return to the commoners' district. I have to think of a way out of this...
say:3:1430218103:1.female: I don't want to return to the commoners' district. I have to think of a way out of this...
